config_validation.note: Full-width rotation would be inv_freq(64, theta) with 32 channels; this checkpoint rotates only 16 channel(s) per head because partial_rotary_factor = 0.25. The 8-channel ladder is a subsample of the full one: its channel k has the frequency the full ladder gives to channel 4k, so partial rotation keeps every 4th frequency and drops the rest, rather than truncating a contiguous block.

position_channels.definition: |B_k| / R_k with R_k = hypot(A_k, B_k): the share of a rotary pair's amplitude that carries position

position_blind_threshold.rationale: the crossed term cannot move the pair's contribution by more than this fraction of the pair's own amplitude

identities.note: residuals are between two float64 summations of vectors that the checkpoint produced in its own dtype, so the floor is set by that dtype and not by the algebra
identities.bilinearity_note: bilinearity_max_rel_err divides by |a * score|, which for a real head is a signed sum of large terms that routinely cancel: it is dominated by how close the head came to zero, not by nonlinearity. bilinearity_max_scaled_err divides by |a| * sum_k |q_k * k_rot_k|, the scale on which bilinearity is actually exact, and is the number to compare against the synthetic one.

linearization.note: content vectors are real activations drawn independently of delta; delta is the gap handed to the closed form. Each (layer, head) entry is the max over that head's content pairs. amplitude_weighted_err is dimensionless because numerator and denominator both scale as a sum of per-pair amplitudes.
